key_points: Pfizer refocusing growth strategy around newer and acquired products while reducing COVID-19 exposure.
New HHS revenue-sharing deal to share higher overseas drug revenue with the U.S., boosting earnings.
Dividend yield remains attractive at 6%+, supporting income‑focused investors.
Management says major headwinds (tariffs, drug‑pricing pressures, patent expiries) are beginning to ease.
Analysts view the stock as undervalued relative to its yield and improving growth prospects.
